caption: The drawing depicts a single square area positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. Inside the square, there is a regular grid of horizontal and vertical lines creating a plaid or checkered pattern. The predominant color within the square is a dark blue or black, intersected by narrower off-white or light gray lines forming a series of smaller squares and rectangles. The lines vary in thickness, with some being single and others composed of a few parallel lines grouped together. The edges of the central square are sharp and clean, and there are no other objects or elements present on the background outside the square.
